purpose: Define portable Current entity identity, Scope/Feature composition, references, provenance, rights and temporal lifecycle for JSON today and PostgreSQL later.
current_architecture: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition

id.description: Global immutable entity identity. It is generated once, persisted and never derived from array index, row number, batch order, timestamp alone, mutable names or filenames.

system_id.description: Canonical language-system identifier. Current system instance: lo3rwang.

scope_id.description: Governed data and authority boundary for this record.

key.description: Human-readable business key. It is not the primary id; domain-specific uniqueness is enforced separately.

feature_ids.description: Reusable capabilities that consume the record's Scope without taking ownership of it.

page_composition_refs.description: Optional UI/page projections; never governance authority.

era_id.description: Business reference to the governed ERA registry when applicable.

work_id.description: Governed business identifier for a work. It is separate from immutable id.

media_id.description: Governed business identifier for a media asset. It is separate from immutable id.

source_refs.description: Evidence references without duplicating canonical content.

provenance.description: Evidence lineage only. Historical definitions live in historical/event records and do not become Current aliases or authority mappings.

lifecycle.timestamp_rule: Do not fabricate legacy timestamps. Unknown values remain null until supported by provenance.

historical_event.description: History references an immutable entity id but never overrides the Current entity definition.

database_contract.business_key_rule: Use separate UNIQUE constraints such as unique(scope_id,key) or unique(scope_id,work_id).

governance_rules: Current architecture is Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition.
Every new Current entity receives one immutable UUIDv7 id; reruns reuse persisted ids.
Array index, row number, batch sequence, file order and timestamp alone are forbidden as permanent entity identity.
Natural-key collisions stop migration for explicit resolution; they are never silently overwritten or renumbered.
History is evidence/reference only. Current Authority interprets History, not the reverse.
Generated data, Search, RAG and UI are projections/consumers and never create governance authority.
NAV is a Frozen Interface and is outside this schema's write authority.
